constraints.description: Automatic/default execution must not exceed 100 Valkey nodes.
constraints.name: default_node_cap

constraints.description: Runtime image must declare a Valkey 9.1.x tag.
constraints.name: valkey_version

constraints.description: Configs must require sandbox networking and forbid host network mutation.
constraints.name: sandbox_network

constraints.description: Multi-AZ profiles use exactly two virtual AZs so each shard's primary and replica live in opposite AZ containers.
constraints.name: two_virtual_azs

constraints.description: 1000-node configs require allow_1000_nodes, opt_in_1000, dry_run_only, and runtime.dry_run.
constraints.name: scale_1000_opt_in

constraints.description: Nodehost density config merge order is built-in defaults < global config < scenario config < CLI override.
constraints.name: nodehost_density_global_merge

constraints.description: cluster-node-timeout merge order is built-in defaults < global config < selected profile < scenario config < CLI override.
constraints.name: cluster_node_timeout_global_profile

constraints.description: Failover timeline observer probe intervals and endpoint fanout merge through the global observability config.
constraints.name: failover_timeline_observer_global_config

constraints.description: Enabled workloads must have read_ratio + write_ratio equal to 1.0.
constraints.name: workload_ratios
